usageNotes: Call this after making changes to SDN zones, VNets, or subnets to push the pending configuration to all cluster nodes and reload the SDN controllers (e.g. OVN, EVPN). Requires the `SDN.Allocate` privilege on `/sdn`. If a `lock-token` was acquired before editing (to prevent concurrent SDN edits), pass it here; `release-lock` defaults to true so the lock is dropped automatically on success.

examples.summary: Apply pending SDN changes and release the configuration lock

tips: Returns a task UPID string — poll the task status endpoint to confirm all nodes applied the config before assuming success.
If no SDN changes are pending, the call still succeeds but triggers a gratuitous reload; safe to call but unnecessary.
Omit `lock-token` if you did not explicitly acquire a lock before editing; passing a stale or wrong token will cause the commit to fail.
In large clusters this is a cluster-wide operation — all nodes must be reachable for a clean reload.
